translation: Use Ruxiang/Frankincense and Moyao/Myrrh, each one liang, ground separately. Next use Xuejie/Dragon's blood, Zirantong/Pyritum, Wumingyi/Pyrolusite, and vinegar-boiled yellow Mubiezi/Semen momordicae, each one liang, and Dilong/earthworm two liang, all ground into a powder, and form honey pills the size of longan fruit. Chew thoroughly and swallow with hot wine. After it is done, chew fresh scallion to resolve it.
